stories.title: 29 teams take on marathon distance at Deeside Athletics Track
stories.summary: A community fitness group has completed a marathon relay at Deeside Athletics Track, with all 29 competing teams finishing the distance in Saturday’s heat. stories.title: Clean-up of Shotton Steelworks land approved as part of £200m manufacturing plan
stories.summary: The first phase in the approval of a £200m manufacturing site at Shotton Steelworks that is expected to create 137 jobs in Flintshire has been given the go-ahead. Flintshire County Council’s Planning Committee has granted approval for work to clean up and prepare 17.68 hectares – an area the size of roughly 25 football pitches

stories.title: Senedd clashes over Plaid’s plan to review Wales funding formula
stories.summary: Senedd Members clashed over plans to review Wales’ funding formula, following the Welsh Government’s defeat in its pursuit for change. Constitution minister Dafydd Trystan Davies defended the Welsh Government’s stance amid Reform calls for the plans to be abandoned. stories.title: Councillor calls for information on unlicensed HMOs in Sandycroft and Pentre
stories.summary: A councillor has appealed for residents to come forward with information on potentially unlicensed Houses in Multiple Occupation in Sandycroft and Pentre.
